questions.subject: English
questions.prompt: In Romeo and Juliet, what technique does Shakespeare use in the Prologue to reveal the ending before the play begins?
questions.why: The Prologue tells the audience the lovers will die, creating dramatic irony — we know their fate while the characters don't, which builds tension throughout.
